meta.title: A survey household
meta.prompt: A household decides how many trips each member makes on the travel day.
meta.selection_rule: Picked by a stated rule: of the 51 households where the learned follow-ups changed the result, the middle one. Household members are Mistral-7B agents.
meta.selection_rule_detail: Seed 0, Mistral-7B household members. Among households where the learned follow-ups acted (rule_first intervened at least twice) and changed the result against the rule alone, the one whose rule_first minus rule fidelity is the lower median; ties go to the smallest household id.
meta.footer: In a separate test of the learned follow-ups (64 households x 5 runs, apart from the 128-household comparison on the project page), the rule plus learned follow-ups matched 5.1 points more of the household's real trips than the rule alone (95% CI +2.1 to +8.0) and 5.5 points more than no moderator (+2.9 to +8.2).
